def true_transform(grid):
  h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0])
  from collections import defaultdict
  cells_by_color=defaultdict(list)
  for r in range(h):
    for c in range(w):
      if grid[r][c]!=0: cells_by_color[grid[r][c]].append((r,c))
  # template color = max count unique
  counts={col:len(v) for col,v in cells_by_color.items()}
  m=max(counts.values())
  tcolors=[col for col,cnt in counts.items() if cnt==m]
  if len(tcolors)!=1: raise
  tc=tcolors[0]
  tpix=cells_by_color[tc]
  top=min(r for r,c in tpix); left=min(c for r,c in tpix)
  local=set((r-top,c-left) for r,c in tpix)
  # placements
  out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
  others=[col for col in cells_by_color if col!=tc]
  for col in others:
    obs=set(cells_by_color[col])
    cands=set()
    for (tr,tcl) in obs:
      for (lr,lc) in local:
        t=tr-lr; l=tcl-lc
        full=set((t+lr2,l+lc2) for lr2,lc2 in local)
        if not obs<=full: continue
        if any(r<0 or r>=h or c<0 or c>=w for r,c in full): continue
        if any(grid[r][c]!=0 and (r,c) not in obs for r,c in full): continue
        if full==obs: continue
        cands.add(frozenset(full))
    # max boundary margin
    def margin(s):
      rs=[r for r,c in s]; cs=[c for r,c in s]
      return min(min(rs),min(cs),h-1-max(rs),w-1-max(cs))
    if cands:
      best=max(margin(c) for c in cands)
      cands={c for c in cands if margin(c)==best}
    if len(cands)!=1: raise
    full=next(iter(cands))
    for r,c in full: out[r][c]=col
  return out
